intent: Provision every external OpenClaw soul into a dedicated, replay-safe, ownership-verified container runtime without mutating incumbent gateways.
invariants: non-dry-run existing-container provisioning is rejected before mutation
image references use immutable OCI digests and source revisions use pinned commits
resource names and ownership labels bind agent, request, run, soul, and spec identity
secret content is supplied only by restrictively permissioned file mounts
reconcile and delete fail closed on any ownership or spec mismatch
